### Off to See the World
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/off-to-see-the-world-one-year-devotions-for-women-january-12.html
Passage: Genesis 34:7
Points:
- Dinah's naive curiosity drove her into pagan environments contrary to God's ways.
- Shechem acted on immediate lust, bringing violation and disgrace upon Jacob's family.
- The brothers responded with deceitful violence, showing how sin quickly multiplies tragedy.
- Believers face a similar temptation to suspect God is withholding worldly pleasures.
- Careless curiosity and worldly compromise ultimately bring widespread grief and dishonor God.

### Dinah's Humiliation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/dinahs-humiliation
Passage: Genesis 34:1-4
Points:
- Jacob failed to learn from past mistakes and permitted his household to assimilate into Canaanite culture.
- Dinah was left exposed to serious moral and physical dangers without proper spiritual protection.
- Shechem yielded to unrestrained lust, directly violating God's moral law and harming an image-bearer.
- Jacob's initial neglect and Shechem's wickedness set off a chain of devastating consequences.
- Dwelling on sinful desires in the heart can quickly escalate into actions that harm ourselves and others.
